WoW: Forever

Paladin

Paladin is a plate-wearing melee fighter that runs on mana, and it is no longer faction-locked. Undead Paladins are new in Forever, with their own class hub in Tirisfal Glades.

WoW: Forever · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. Forever's beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Paladin build has been tested. Published level-30 builds elsewhere spend points on CrusadeCrusadeTalentCastInstantIncreases all damage dealt by 2%. Increased by an additional 2% against Demon and Undead targets. and Improved Holy StrikeImproved Holy StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.. Both still exist in the newest client build, 1.60.1.70245, so neither has been deleted outright. Whether you can still reach them in the tree is the part nobody can check: the client's talent tables have not been updated for Forever, and Paladin is the one class Blizzard has not written a deep dive for. Treat any level-30 Paladin build you find as a projection.

Protection used to have dungeon levelling as its escape hatch, and that route is largely gone. Forever cut dungeon experience hard, and the October 1 build cut dungeon quest experience too: dungeon quests now reward 50% less extra experience beyond normal quest values. Blizzard framed the cut as a deliberate reduction in levelling speed.

The two talents stand on very different evidence. The client's own Holy Strike row agrees on the 10 seconds while keeping the talent's separate record, which it also does for talents Blizzard has confirmed deleted. Is Paladin for you?

Play Paladin if you want a melee class that carries its own heals, wears mail from level 1 and plate from 40, and can train for whichever of the three roles a group is short of.

Strengths

  • Heals itself in every spec: Holy LightHoly LightLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 9Cast2.5 sec castCost35 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 43. from level 1, Lay on HandsLay on HandsLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange40 yd rangeCooldown1200 sec cooldownHeals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration. from 10, Divine ShieldDivine ShieldLevel 34 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost75 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secProtects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active. from 34
  • Covers all three group roles — Seal of FurySeal of FuryLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secFills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts23 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec. taunts from 10, and the heals need no talent points
  • Blessings and auras apply to the whole party, and Blessings now last a full hour

Weaknesses

  • Holy and Protection spend their talent points on healing and threat rather than damage
  • Runs on mana: Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage., JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. all draw on the same bar

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? Three buttons: keep a seal up, judge it, strike on cooldown.

Is it forgiving? You heal yourself, wear mail from level 1 and plate from 40, and get Divine ShieldDivine ShieldLevel 34 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost75 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secProtects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active. at 34.

What carries you while levelling? Retribution carries the damage: Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage. from level 6, a two-hander, and ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. added at 20.

Does it need a group? No. Every spec trains heals and a taunt, so you can fill whatever a group lacks.

Which race

Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation. No race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP. The ones that matter there break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm), Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome, roots and snares) and StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. (Dwarf, bleeds, poisons and disease). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

Alliance: Human or Dwarf. Human's Sword SpecializationSword SpecializationTalent · Rank 1 of 14CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2% while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped. gives +2% crit to spells and abilities off a sword carried purely as a stat stick. It is the largest weapon racial, and it feeds both gearing paths. Dwarf's StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. is a real solo cooldown.

Horde: Undead, and it is forced, being the only Horde Paladin. It is good anyway. CannibalizeCannibalizeTalentCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown120 sec cooldownWhen activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect. now restores 35% health and mana, which on a mana-using melee class is close to a free recovery on every corpse.

Paladin is no longer Alliance-only. Undead Paladins get their own hub at Bandarion Keep in the previously inaccessible Whispering Wood, Tirisfal Glades, and their own level 40 and 60 mount quests.

Quality of life

  • Seals, Blessings and Auras are three separate always-on systems, and new players drop one. Set an aura and forget it. Keep a blessing on yourself. Keep a seal up always: Judgement no longer consumes your seal in Forever, so there is no excuse for letting it lapse.
  • Retribution AuraRetribution AuraLevel 16 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledCauses 7 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time. has a live bug as of October 1: it reflects damage using the target's spell power rather than the Paladin's. Blizzard lists it under Known Issues rather than intended design, so expect a fix. Do not build around what it does today.
  • Only one-handed maces are known by default. Every other weapon skill, including all two-handers, must be bought from a weapon master. Polearms from 20.
  • Do the level-20 class quest, which rewards a deliberately over-budgeted weapon. Alliance get Verigan's Fist from The Test of Righteousness. Horde get Wolfsbane, even slower and more powerful, from Diplomatic Incident, starting at level 18 in Bandarion Keep.
  • ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. at 20 changes the class from single-target to area-capable, and every spec now gets it. Budget mana for it.

At level 60

Unknown. No source publishes a Paladin build past 30, so whether Retribution's Seal of Command path or the new Spell Power path wins is untested. Raids open December 9.

Sources
